summary.text: Trojan whom godlike Euryalus slew when he went on after Dresus in the battle of *Iliad* 6 — distinct from Opheltius the Danaan leader whom Hector laid low in *Iliad* 11.

story.text: When Diomedes had smitten Acamas chiefest among the Thracians, Euryalus slew Dresus and Opheltius, and went on after Aesepus and Pedasus, whom the fountain-nymph Abarbarea bare to peerless Bucolion, son of lordly Laomedon.
